doc.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012

title: Closing talk about Monk Rowe's nickname and goodbye
summary: Rowe wraps up, explains his nickname came from a hooded coat, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I have to have my open house here so I’m going to wrap up and maybe down the line we’ll do part two.
Monk you are way too kind to me and I’m grateful. How cool is your name. I mean, for who were you named? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

Actually it was a nickname I picked up in college, and most people thought it was about Thelonious, but actually it was about a blue coat with a hood. And it stuck with me and eventually I became the name.
You were wearing hoodies before they were cool, huh? Awesome.
Well thanks for your time today and I hope your gig here at Hamilton goes well and that you make your 2 a.m. bus. We’ll make sure that you’re there.
Okay. Over and out. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
